description: Real, documented design-system classes that are NOT tiled components — the untiled core layer for page assembly. Consumed by cross-registry coverage checking.
note: ogds-elements 1.0.0-beta.2 ships no global utility layer — its components bundle their own layout rules inside their shadow stylesheets (the banner's USWDS-derived grid classes are listed here because tiles use them for page-adjacent layout). Token-driven styling of plain HTML uses the --ogds-theme-* / --ogds-color-* / --ogds-spacing-* custom properties documented in ogds-tokens.css.
